crossRefs.note: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus, my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into…
He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
Everyone went to his own house,
Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will…
Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

translations.web: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.
translations.bsb: And after we had said our farewells, we went aboard the ship, and they returned home.
translations.kjv: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
translations.asv: and we went on board the ship, but they returned home again.
